job.title: backend developer onlineshop und dm app java kotlin w m d

tailoring.headline: Backend Developer Onlineshop & Java | SAP Commerce Cloud & Spring Boot
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using Java, Spring Boot and SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in RESTful APIs, microservices, database performance tuning, and data integration across PIM and ERP systems. Experienced in agile delivery, CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with international business and technical stakeholders. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: backend developer onlineshop und dm app java kotlin w m d
cover_en.hook: As an experienced backend developer based in Karlsruhe with over 5 years of enterprise e-commerce expertise at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply for your backend developer role for the onlineshop and app. I bring deep technical proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, and scalable platform architectures.

bullets.label: Java & Spring Backend Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud using Java and Spring, ensuring high performance, scalability, and adherence to clean code patterns.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integration Depth
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, customizing Interceptors, Populators, and Converters for seamless system communication and data flow.

bullets.label: Database Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring, optimized FlexibleSearch and SQL queries, and tuned system performance to reduce response latency and secure transactional speed.

bullets.label: Agile Enterprise Delivery
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2, worked closely with international product and technical teams in agile environments, and maintained rigorous unit test coverage with JUnit.

cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15.12.2026, making me available to start from 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how my backend expertise adds value to dm-drogerie markt.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als backend developer onlineshop und dm app java kotlin w m d
cover_de.hook: Als erfahrene Backend-Entwicklerin mit Wohnsitz in Karlsruhe und über 5 Jahren fundierter Praxis bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich tiefgehende Expertise in Java, Spring Boot und skalierbaren E-Commerce-Architekturen mit, um Ihren Onlineshop und Ihre App nachhaltig zu stärken.

bullets.label: Java- & Spring-Backend
bullets.text: Entwicklung robuster Backend-Funktionalitäten und Services auf Basis von Java und Spring unter Einhaltung von Clean-Code-Prinzipien und Enterprise-Architekturmustern.

bullets.label: REST-APIs & Integrationen
bullets.text: Bereitstellung von OCC-REST-Webservices und Headless-APIs sowie Implementierung kundenspezifischer Interceptoren, Populatoren und Converters für reibungslose Datenflüsse.

bullets.label: Datenbankoptimierung
bullets.text: Durchführung von Datenbank-Query-Refactorings und Optimierung von FlexibleSearch- sowie SQL-Abfragen zur Senkung von Latenzen und Steigerung der Transaktionsgeschwindigkeit.

bullets.label: Agile Umsetzung & CI/CD
bullets.text: Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployment-Zyklen auf CCv2-Plattformen, enge Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Stakeholdern in agilen Teams sowie Sicherstellung hoher Code-Qualität mittels JUnit.

cover_de.logistics: Ich verfüge über eine unbeschränkte deutsche Arbeitserlaubnis. Mein letzter Arbeitstag im Rahmen meiner Kündigungsfrist ist der 15.12.2026; mein frühester Eintrittstermin ist der 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: dm-drogerie markt stands for customer-centric retail innovation and digital excellence in e-commerce. As a developer based in Karlsruhe, I am inspired by dm's technological scale and digital platforms. I want to contribute my 5+ years of enterprise Java, Spring, and API development experience to build high-performance backend systems for your onlineshop and mobile applications.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of Java, Spring, and enterprise e-commerce backend expertise in Karlsruhe to power robust onlineshop and app architectures at dm.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of Java, Spring, and e-commerce backend experience at Rockwell and Shell, plus local presence in Karlsruhe, I'd love to bring my expertise to dm's onlineshop & app team. Valid work permit, available from 16.12.2026. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Backend Developer Onlineshop & App – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am applying for the backend developer position for the onlineshop and app at dm-drogerie markt. With over 5 years of professional backend experience in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, and enterprise e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical delivery skills to your team.

My CV and cover letter are attached. I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit, serving notice until 15.12.2026, and available from 16.12.2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
